pricing.purchase_cast: Purchase control narrows computed unit price to signed16 before wallet comparison; ordinary UI values remain in range.
pricing.individual_editor: Temporary26-value delta array. Commit writes all26; cancel does not write them back. Direction edits stop at setting0/100.
pricing.group_editor: Raise all26 by1 only if none is>=100; lower all26 by1 only if none is<=0. Do not clamp each item independently.
pricing.meaning: Setting1 step changes coefficient by1 percentage point of source base price, not1 monetary unit and not1% of procurement cost.

store_metrics.price_raw: Summary+00: running average of cost_percent+setting for every anchored fixture with a recognized product image, exceptcash26; quantity0 does not itself exclude an image.
store_metrics.service_raw: Summary+0C, normalized at+A4. Not security at+08. Earlier helper variables namedsecurity in this path refer to service.
store_metrics.carryover: Native23C20 clears stack+48(count),+4C(parking),+50(price accumulator) before physical-store loop0..9 only. Later active stores inherit all three; price accumulator has already been divided for prior store. Preserve as a source quirk rather than silently resetting per store.

candidate_gates: One RNG for rating gate per store in order; continue only if rand()%100+1<=store rating+20.
Schedule must be open at profile signed byte+2 arrival hour.
Arrival mode3 requires summary parking capacity>0.
Primary product profile+8 stock must be>0. Other stock cannot substitute.
ranking: price_norm*profile+14 + distance_norm*profile+15 + service_norm*profile+16; highest score wins.
wallet: Not part of candidate ranking; later purchase control compares per-person current wallet against unit price.
limits: This report links existing algorithms to complete named master data and exact source fields; it does not claim each formula is newly discovered.
Store-order/carryover behavior is from the original code, not a desired economic design.
No approximation of these weights as independent percentages or new probabilistic model.
